cases.purpose: A batch of n identical units contains exactly n elements.

cases.purpose: Mirroring a binary tree twice restores its entire structure.

cases.purpose: Reject overflowing U32 addition before performing it.
cases.oracle: a+b fits iff b <= max-a. 0+0 and max+0 fit; (max-1)+1 fits at max; max+1 and 2147483648+2147483648 overflow.

cases.purpose: Handle zero separately and reject overflowing U32 products.

cases.purpose: Erase generic types while moving heterogeneous values through a pair helper.

cases.purpose: Require Data only for the generic operation that actually duplicates its input.
cases.oracle: Duplicating 0 yields two zeros, Versioned{7} yields two equal domain snapshots, and True yields two True values.

cases.purpose: Reuse closed top-level and lambda operations through a template.

cases.purpose: Compose two affine runtime closures and call each exactly once.

cases.purpose: Repeat an operation with a runtime Data parameter instead of copying a captured closure.

cases.purpose: Convert Nat unit counts through U32 and exact binary fractions for fixed quarter-unit billing.

cases.purpose: Apply a bounded sensor calibration with computed F32 comparisons passed to helpers.
cases.oracle: Clamp to [0,1], then scale by 100: -0.5=>0, 0=>0, .25=>25, 1=>100, 1.5=>100. All fractions and products are exactly binary-representable. Runtime-only: Bend 2.0.39 normalization leaves these F32 primitives unevaluated; exact JavaScript execution is required.

cases.purpose: Traverse a finite grid with a lexicographically decreasing pair and a resettable column counter.
cases.oracle: Rows=0 visits no cells; zero-width rows visit none; 1x1 gives 1, 2x3 gives 6, and 3x2 plus initial tally 4 gives 10.

cases.purpose: Reuse only matched numeric fields while consuming a domain record once.
cases.oracle: A rectangle reports area and perimeter: 0x0 => (0,0), 0x4 => (0,8), 3x4 => (12,14).

cases.purpose: Store an affine callback in a Type-kinded domain and consume it through pattern matching.

cases.purpose: Sequence two fallible decimal reads without confusing valid zero with failure.

cases.purpose: Clip and reverse Unicode code points without treating UTF-8 bytes as characters; check list conversion round-trip.

cases.purpose: Accept exactly three delimiter-separated fields while preserving empty field positions and rejecting missing/extra fields.
cases.oracle: a,b,c and a,,c have exactly 3 fields; ,, has 3 empty fields; empty input has 1 field; a,b, has 3; a,b,c,d has 4.

cases.purpose: Apply explicit decimal token grammar and reject signs, spaces, Unicode digits and U32 overflow.

cases.purpose: Prefer explicit seconds, fall back to a default token, convert to milliseconds, then use a final 1000ms default.

cases.purpose: Traverse numeric rows with Result, preserving the first invalid row and accepting an empty batch.

cases.purpose: Recover independently from malformed numeric rows, returning total and rejected-row count.
cases.oracle: [2,x,0,3] sums valid rows to 5 and rejects 1; [] => 0/0; [empty,bad] => 0/2; [0] => 0/0.

cases.purpose: Count repeated string keys using owner-threaded map reads and report absent-key defaults.

cases.purpose: Apply right-hand configuration overrides, remove a retired key, and distinguish an absent key through a supplied default.

cases.purpose: Normalize tags, remove duplicate and empty tags, and render in deterministic sorted order.
